Financial Analyst Japanese Bilingual

Remote work is available.
 *Expert-level Japanese proficiency is required, as financial reports must be prepared in Japanese**

Company: Residential homebuilding and development company that is part of a major Japanese housing and building materials group.

Position: Financial Analyst / Accounting & Administrative Assistant (Depending on Experience) (DOE)

Job Location: Dallas, TX or Rockville, MD *Remote work available

Working Schedule: Full-time (part-time could be negotiable)

Salary range: $60K + bonus (negotiable depending on skills and experience)

Job Description

Financial Reporting & Analysis
 Prepare monthly and consolidated financial reporting packages for U.S. subsidiary company to be submitted to the headquarters in Japan.
 Analyze financial performance and provide commentary on key trends, variances, and operational drivers.
 Consolidate financial data from multiple U.S. entities and ensure accuracy and consistency in reporting.
 Gather qualitative insights and operational updates from branch managers across 19 U.S. locations and incorporate them into reports for headquarters.
 Support management in performance monitoring and business analysis through financial data interpretation and reporting.

Accounting Operations
 Maintain bookkeeping records for subsidiary companies and ensure accurate financial documentation.
 Process invoices related to office operations (e.g., lease payments) and manage approval workflows.
 Issue and track invoices and oversee the collection process.
 Maintain and manage billing-related records and documentation.

Coordination & Communication
 Collaborate closely with Japanese expatriate management and local leadership to gather financial and operational information.
 Facilitate communication between U.S. operations and the headquarters in Japan regarding financial performance and reporting requirements.

General Affairs
 Support general administrative and office management tasks as needed.

3a4c84c24b2a5bf2.description:
We are looking for a motivated software engineer to join our Applied AI team. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will work alongside senior engineers to design, build, and deploy AI-driven systems for real-world client use cases.

At Newtuple, junior engineers don’t work on toy problems. You will contribute to production-grade AI systems across domains such as RAG applications, intelligent automation, LLM-powered tools, data pipelines, and enterprise AI integrations. You will learn to move quickly from idea to working prototype, and from prototype to production, while developing strong engineering fundamentals. A key expectation for this role is openness to AI-assisted development. You should be comfortable using AI coding tools, debugging assistants, and LLM-driven workflows to accelerate learning and development.

Key Responsibilities:

A. Applied AI development
1. Assist in building and deploying AI-powered applications such as RAG systems, chatbots, workflow automation tools, and data enrichment pipelines.
2. Work with APIs for LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, etc.) and integrate them into backend systems.
3. Contribute to prompt engineering, evaluation experiments, and iterative model improvements.
4. Support implementation of vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and basic agent workflows.

B. Software engineering
1. Develop backend features and APIs using Python, Node.js, Go, or similar technologies.
2. Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code under the guidance of senior engineers.
3. Participate in designing microservices and modular systems that power AI applications.
4. Translate loosely defined requirements into functional prototypes and production features.
5. Work across multiple projects and adapt to different technical stacks and client contexts.

3a1bd7d19dad533e.description: Join arenaflex: Shape the Future of Streaming Entertainment Through Data Are you passionate about the intersection of data analytics and entertainment Do you thrive on transforming complex datasets into actionable insights that influence business decisions on a global scale If so, arenaflex invites you to join our dynamic Streaming Analytics team as we continue to revolutionize how audiences discover and engage with premium content worldwide. At arenaflex, we believe that data is the backbone of exceptional entertainment experiences. Our Streaming Information and Analytics division is at the forefront of content strategy, leveraging cutting-edge analytical techniques to understand viewer preferences, optimize content delivery, and shape the future of digital entertainment. As a Data Analyst within our Advanced Analytics and Content team, you will play a pivotal role in driving data-informed decisions that impact millions of viewers worldwide. About the Role We are seeking a talented and motivated Data Analyst to become an integral part of our High-Performance Analytics and Content team. In this role, you will join a group of passionate data professionals who apply rigorous analytical methodologies to enhance our content portfolio, refine our marketing strategies, and optimize our delivery processes. You will have the opportunity to work with massive datasets spanning viewer behaviors, content performance metrics, and market trends. The ideal candidate for this position possesses exceptional analytical capabilities, thrives in a fast-paced dynamic environment, loves tackling complex problems, has strong attention to detail, and maintains genuine enthusiasm for television and film content. If you derive personal satisfaction from using data to drive business decisions and are eager to continue learning and growing within a cutting-edge technology company, this is an exceptional opportunity for you. What You'll Do As a Data Analyst at arenaflex, your contributions will directly impact how we create, acquire, and deliver content to our global audience. Your responsibilities will include: Advanced Analytics Implementation: Apply sophisticated analytical techniques including data mining, data visualization, statistical analysis, and machine learning algorithms to large-scale, high-dimensional datasets. You will extract meaningful patterns and insights that drive critical business decisions across the organization. Viewer Behavior Analysis: Conduct deep-dive analyses into customer behavior patterns, including content type preferences, viewing habits, engagement trends, and consumption patterns. Your insights will help identify underserved customer needs and uncover hidden content opportunities that can expand our audience reach. Content Performance Prediction: Develop predictive models to forecast content engagement levels, helping to guide strategic acquisition decisions and inform our content investment portfolio. You will build models that anticipate viewer responses to various content offerings. Release Strategy Optimization: Contribute to refining our reputed company and episode release strategies by analyzing historical performance data, viewer engagement metrics, and market dynamics. Your recommendations will help maximize content visibility and viewer retention. Marketing Campaign Testing: Design and analyze A/B tests and multivariate experiments to evaluate marketing strategies aimed at improving viewer engagement and reducing churn. You will provide data-driven recommendations to enhance our marketing effectiveness. Metric Innovation: Ideate, develop, and implement new measurement frameworks and KPIs that accurately assess content performance. You will create metrics that serve both tactical operational decisions and strategic long-term planning initiatives. Ad-Hoc Analysis Support: Provide responsive analytical support to cross-functional partners across the organization, helping to address urgent business questions and drive immediate improvements. Compelling Data Storytelling: Effectively communicate complex analytical findings through persuasive data storytelling, translating technical insights into clear, actionable recommendations accessible to stakeholders at all levels of the organization. What to Bring We are looking for candidates who possess the following qualifications and skills: Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, or equivalent quantitative discipline. Your academic foundation will provide the analytical framework necessary for success in this role. Professional Ex .
